name: Record completed game scores once through the shared module
instruction: A scored game's completed round records its final score exactly once through recordScore from src/carnival; the game does not keep an independent high-score store.
relevant_when: A src/games/<game-id>/game.ts file defines a scored CarnivalGame with a round-ending state or condition.
context: AGENTS.md house rule 2 routes scores through the shared scores module, which owns browser storage and the midway scoreboard.
scope_reason: The game's score, end-of-round transition, recording call, and any direct storage use are visible in its game.ts file.

checklist.name: single-final-record
checklist.rule: When a round ends, the final score is passed to recordScore with that game's id once, including when the render or update loop runs again; replay allows the next round to record once.

checklist.name: shared-score-storage
checklist.rule: The game does not directly read or write localStorage or sessionStorage for scores, or maintain a separate high-score table.
